dataset: CGMacros v1.0.0; 45 participants; audit is descriptive

field_availability.meal_timestamp: Timestamp on participant minute-grid; meal events marked by Meal Type or positive Carbs
field_availability.meal_macros: Carbs, Protein, Fat, Fiber, Calories; counts of nonmissing meal-event values are reported below
field_availability.activity: participant files vary: METs (documented as MET x10), Intensity, Calories (Activity), or Steps
field_availability.heart_rate: HR in bpm, sampled on minute grid where available
field_availability.cgm: Libre GL and Dexcom GL in mg/dL; timestamps are randomly shifted study times
field_availability.bio: Fasting GLU - PDL (Lab) mg/dL and Insulin mcU/mL at study start

privacy: Per-participant meal counts are saved only under git-ignored data/processed/twin_step1/. No per-sample outputs are written here.
